from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import shutil, py_compile, sys

ROOT = Path('/home/steven/Desktop/OBSIDION').resolve()

FILES = {
    'arch': CORE / 'ArchitectureIntelligence.py',
    'build': CORE / 'BuildIntelligence.py',
    'prov': CORE / 'ProvenanceIntelligence.py',
    'brain': CORE / 'EngineBrain.py',
    'manager': CORE / 'FrameworkManager.py',
    'report': CORE / 'ReportingSystem.py',
}
STAMP = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
BACKUP = ROOT / '_FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION_BACKUPS' / f'EIF_FINAL_{STAMP}'


def replace_between(text, start, end, replacement):
    a = text.find(start)
    if a < 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f'missing start marker: {start!r}')
    b = text.find(end, a + len(start))
    if b < 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f'missing end marker: {end!r}')
    return text[:a] + replacement.rstrip() + '\n\n' + text[b:]


def backup():
    BACKUP.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for p in FILES.values():
        if p.exists():
            q = BACKUP / p.relative_to(ROOT)
            q.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(p, q)
            print('[BACKUP]', p.relative_to(ROOT))


def rollback():
    print('[ROLLBACK] restoring previous framework')
    for p in FILES.values():
        q = BACKUP / p.relative_to(ROOT)
        if q.exists():
            shutil.copy2(q, p)
    print('[ROLLBACK] complete')


def patch_architecture():
    p = FILES['arch']
    t = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

    add_node = '''    def add_node(self, node_type, name, **metadata):

        # One graph node per qualified type identity. Kind is metadata,
        # never part of identity.
        key = f"Type:{name}"

        node = self.nodes.get(key)

        if node is None:
            node = {
                "type": node_type,
                "name": name,
            }
            self.nodes[key] = node

        elif node.get("type") == "Type" and node_type != "Type":
            node["type"] = node_type

        node.update(metadata)
        return key
'''
    t = replace_between(t, '    def add_node(', '    def add_edge(', add_node)

    hist_node = '''    def _add_historical_node(
        self,
        node_type,
        name,
        **metadata,
    ):

        key = f"Type:{name}"

        node = self.historical_nodes.get(key)

        if node is None:
            node = {
                "type": node_type,
                "name": name,
            }
            self.historical_nodes[key] = node

        elif node.get("type") == "Type" and node_type != "Type":
            node["type"] = node_type

        node.update(metadata)
        return key
'''
    t = replace_between(t, '    def _add_historical_node(', '    def _add_historical_edge(', hist_node)

    get_node = '''    def get_node(self, name):

        key = f"Type:{name}"
        return key if key in self.nodes else None
'''
    t = replace_between(t, '    def get_node(', '    def inheritance_children(', get_node)

    hget = '''    def _historical_node(
        self,
        name,
    ):

        key = f"Type:{name}"
        return key if key in self.historical_nodes else None
'''
    t = replace_between(t, '    def _historical_node(', '    def historical_inheritance_parents(', hget)

    t = t.replace('VERSION = "2.0.0"', 'VERSION = "3.0.0"', 1)
    p.write_text(t, encoding='utf-8')
    print('[PATCH] ArchitectureIntelligence canonical node identity')

def patch_provenance():
    p = FILES['prov']
    t = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

    if '    def analyze(self, architecture=None, reference=None):' not in t:
        marker = '    # ==========================================================\n    # Statistics\n'
        method = '''    # ==========================================================
    # Evidence assimilation
    # ==========================================================

    def analyze(self, architecture=None, reference=None):

        active = 0
        inherited = 0
        references = 0
        compatible = 0

        if architecture is not None:

            for full_name, record in architecture.types.items():

                self.add_concept(
                    full_name,
                    system="OBSIDION",
                    generation=2,
                    canonical=True,
                    status="ACTIVE",
                    sources=list(record.get("sources", [])),
                )

                active += 1

            for child in architecture.types:

                for parent in architecture.inheritance_parents(child):

                    self.add_concept(
                        parent,
                        system="OBSIDION",
                        generation=1,
                    )

                    self.add_relationship(
                        parent,
                        "DERIVED_FROM",
                        child,
                        confidence=1.0,
                        evidence=[
                            f"Active Runtime inheritance: {child} derives from {parent}"
                        ],
                        status="ACTIVE",
                    )

                    inherited += 1

        if reference is not None:

            for full_name, record in reference.types.items():

                ref_name = f"ServUO::{full_name}"

                self.add_concept(
                    ref_name,
                    system="ServUO",
                    generation=0,
                    source=record.get("source"),
                    kind=record.get("kind"),
                )

                references += 1

                if architecture is not None and architecture.knows_type(full_name):

                    self.add_relationship(
                        ref_name,
                        "COMPATIBILITY_WITH",
                        full_name,
                        confidence=0.8,
                        evidence=[
                            "Same qualified type exists in ServUO reference and active OBSIDION."
                        ],
                        interpretation="structural correspondence only",
                    )

                    compatible += 1

        return {
            "concepts": self.total_concepts(),
            "relationships": self.total_relationships(),
            "active_concepts": active,
            "active_inheritance": inherited,
            "reference_concepts": references,
            "compatibility_links": compatible,
        }

'''
        if marker not in t:
            raise RuntimeError('Provenance statistics marker missing')
        t = t.replace(marker, method + marker, 1)

    t = t.replace('VERSION = "1.0.0"', 'VERSION = "2.0.0"', 1)
    p.write_text(t, encoding='utf-8')
    print('[PATCH] ProvenanceIntelligence executable evidence stage')
